Module com.example.miniproyecto_50zo
Package com.example.miniproyecto_50zo.model

Class Card

java.lang.Object
com.example.miniproyecto_50zo.model.Card
public class Card extends Object
Represents a single playing card in the Cincuentazo game. Each card has a Suit, a Rank, and a face state indicating whether it is visible (face-up) or hidden (face-down).

  • Method Details

    • getValue

      public int getValue(int currentSum)
      Returns the effective game value of this card given the current table sum. For Rank.ACE: returns 10 if adding 10 does not exceed 50, otherwise returns 1. For all other ranks: returns the fixed base value from Rank.getBaseValue().
      Parameters:
      currentSum - the current sum on the table before playing this card
      Returns:
      the integer value this card contributes to the table sum

    • isPlayable

      public boolean isPlayable(int currentSum)
      Returns true if playing this card keeps the table sum at or below 50.
      Parameters:
      currentSum - the current sum on the table before playing this card
      Returns:
      true if the card is legally playable
